$comment: Local IPC only. Device-local application names and identifiers; never uploaded, logged, or included in crash diagnostics.
title: UnclassifiedTriage

entries.description: Ranked by seconds_observed, longest first. Capped at 8 and floored at 5 minutes observed: a list of thirty one-second curiosities is not a task anyone will do. An empty array is the good state.

items.$comment: app_stable_id is the only identifier, on purpose. The bundle identity that lets a saved rule survive a rename is looked up in Rust from the rows it already holds when set_application_category comes back; sending it to the client would put a second application identifier on the socket for no use. Until 2026-09-25 this schema declared an optional bundle_id that no Rust build ever sent.

app_stable_id.description: The app-scoped correction key, returned verbatim in set_application_category.

display_name.description: Device-local application name Velvt already holds. Display text only.

window_days.description: The window the entries were computed over, after clamping.
